title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Silicon Bring-up
descriptionText: Lead silicon bring-up, post-silicon validation and customer qualification for a new ASIC. Own NPI from tape-out to volume production across hardware, firmware and test. Manage risk, dependencies and executive stakeholders. Requirements: 8+ years of technical program management in semiconductor or hardware; OEM and ODM customer programs.
